items.title: Ethereum schedules Glamsterdam upgrade on Sepolia for Oct. 6
items.summary: Glamsterdam will bring proposer-builder separation, block-level access lists and new gas pricing, while its mainnet date remains unset.

items.title: Metaplanet directors push back against shareholder fury over a controversial executive payout plan
items.summary: Independent directors cite management’s financial risk and restructuring role, but leave questions about Gerovich’s exercised shares and MMXX Ventures unanswered.

items.title: OpenAI seeks $30 billion in funding at whopping $1.4 trillion valuation after delaying IPO
items.summary: The ChatGPT maker is pursuing fresh funding after delaying its public listing, while expanding its AI tools despite mounting safety concerns.

items.title: How European investors can now buy bitcoin without taking on U.S. dollar risk
items.summary: Asset management platform HANetf has listed ETCs in London, Frankfurt and Paris providing pound sterling and euro-hedged exposure to bitcoin.

items.title: Robinhood unveils an AI that trades your money 24/7, and you carry all the risk
items.summary: Robinhood users could soon get an AI agent that trades on their behalf, even at 2 a.m. But if a trade goes wrong, users' bear the risk, not Robinhood.

items.title: Trump accord calls for tech firms to ‘self police’ their own frontier AI
items.summary: The voluntary accord puts much of the responsibility for managing frontier AI risks on developers.

items.title: Tether says it helped freeze $550M in Iran-linked USDT this year
items.summary: The disclosure came as Senate Democratic investigators alleged USDT had become a key part of Iran’s shadow banking network.

items.title: Cardano tapped by Brazil’s state oil giant to track cleaner jet fuel and diesel
items.summary: Petrobras is testing the blockchain in two research projects aimed at preventing emissions benefits from being counted twice and tracing fuel data across production and use.

items.title: A stronger dollar is a weaker threat to bitcoin than traders think
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 30, 2026

items.title: Bitget hackers move $4 million into Zcash’s private pool, making funds harder to trace
items.summary: Three transfers pushed about 15% of the stolen ZEC into Ironwood, where payments hide their senders, recipients and amounts.

items.title: The SEC Is finally modernizing transfer-agent rules. Wall Street must not repeat the ‘paperwork crisis’
items.summary: If ownership data is split across a token wrapper, a special-purpose vehicle (SPV), a broker’s internal ledger and a transfer agent's off-chain database, we are setting the stage for a Paperwork Crisis for the blockchain age, argues Fairmint’s Joris Delanoue.

items.title: OpenAI, Google and Meta pledge outside AI audits under voluntary White House deal
items.summary: Six companies signed a safety pact covering hacking and biological threats, with no penalties or deadline for putting the checks in place.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin gains as yields dip following better than hoped inflation numbers
items.summary: Core PCE prices rose just 0.2% in August versus the 0.3% forecast, and were higher by 3% year-over-year versus the 3.3% estimate.

items.title: Bitcoin stalls near $83,000 while lighter drops 17% on Robinhood perps plan
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $83,000 as the 30-year Treasury yield topped 5.6%, while DeFi tokens reversed and lighter fell after Robinhood unveiled U.S. perps.

items.title: Winklevoss-owned Gemini switches Zcash software ahead of faster 25-second blocks
items.summary: The new Zakura nodes caught up with the network in just over six hours in Gemini’s deployments. The crypto exchange’s previous software took close to a day.

items.title: Bitcoin bulls have one price level to defend
items.summary: Here's the level analysts are watching and what a break below it could mean for the bulls.

items.title: XRP Ledger starts carrying fund records from Brazil operator overseeing $4 trillion
items.summary: The regulated operator is mirroring ownership of selected investment funds on XRPL while keeping its existing database as the official record.

items.title: Bitcoin rally shows signs of cooling even as a 'bull score' gauge nears its perfect score
items.summary: A trend guage tracked on onchain analysis firm CryptoQuant is near its ceiling. The buyers who drove BTC to an eight-month high are already pulling back.

items.title: Singapore crypto activity grows 55% as broader region contracts
items.summary: Singapore’s crypto economy grew 55.4% to $284 billion as institutional-platform activity surged 94%, while the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam stood out for small-value P2P transfers.

items.title: FCA opens crypto authorization window ahead of 2027 UK regime
items.summary: Crypto businesses should apply by Feb. 28, 2027, while existing money laundering registrations will not convert into FCA authorization.
